optimized_sql:
WITH item_filtered AS (
    SELECT i_brand_id brand_id, i_brand brand, i_item_sk
    FROM item
    WHERE i_manufact_id = 816
)
SELECT dt.d_year 
       , itf.brand_id 
       , itf.brand 
       , sum(ss_sales_price) sum_agg 
FROM date_dim dt 
JOIN store_sales ss ON dt.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk AND dt.d_moy = 11
JOIN item_filtered itf ON ss.ss_item_sk = itf.i_item_sk
GROUP BY dt.d_year, itf.brand, itf.brand_id 
ORDER BY dt.d_year, sum_agg desc, brand_id 
LIMIT 100
